## Description
Briefly describe the change, rationale, and problem it solves.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the existing architectural conventions of Focus Reader Pro (100% client-side, drift-free rAF clock, Vanilla CSS design tokens).
- [ ] I have verified that all unit tests pass (`npm test -- --run`).
- [ ] I have verified that the production build succeeds without TypeScript or bundling errors (`npm run build`).
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation if my change introduces new user interactions or configurations.
- [ ] I have tested across light and dark visual themes.
